exposure: gestational diabetes mellitus (GDM) diagnosed during early pregnancy
gestational diabetes mellitus (GDM) diagnosed during late pregnancy
finding: Early-onset GDM was associated with poorer pregnancy outcomes, including lower Apgar scores, increased risk of neonatal respiratory distress syndrome, and higher NICU admission rates, compared to late-onset GDM.
mod_finding: Gestational diabetes mellitus was associated with an increased risk of cesarean section regardless of whether it was diagnosed early or late in pregnancy.
